neighbours.label: a word at the start of a contrasting clause (While it ..., whereas others ...)
fire: I no longer take this pill. While it doesn't hurt, it costs too much.
This model is strong. While the frame is light, it breaks often.
I no longer drink this tea. While it tastes fine, it keeps me awake.
Her plan is cheap. Even so, the board said no.
The phone is fast. While the screen is sharp, the battery is poor.
He kept the car. Rather than sell it, he fixed the brakes.
This stove is old. While it still works, it wastes gas.
We tried the cafe. While the coffee is good, the food is not.
quiet: I no longer take this pill. It hurts, and it costs too much.
This model is strong. The frame is light, and it lasts.
I no longer drink this tea. It tastes bad and keeps me awake.
Her plan is cheap. So the board said yes.
The phone is fast. The screen is sharp, and the battery is good.
He kept the car. He fixed the brakes on Friday.
This stove is old. It works and uses little gas.
We tried the cafe. The coffee is good, and the food is too.

notes: Card: ' While' x5, '.' x5, ' but' x4, ' because' x3, ' Even' x2, ' since' x2, ' whereas', ' Rather'. Probes were weak: ' While' 0.187, 'arily' 0.071, ' when' 0.070, ' whereas' under 0.02. Likely to fail on the median.
